verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a code-review SaaS, but the evidence only shows adjacent capabilities. Central configuration applies one .coderabbit.yaml across an entire organization's repositories (coderabbit-docs-14), and Triage gives a single cross-repository PR queue with filtering and grouping (coderabbit-docs-32, coderabbit-docs-34). The documented Triage actions (review, repair, reassign, close) apply to one pull request at a time (coderabbit-docs-35), so there is no evidence of multi-select bulk actions. Missing for 10: bulk-select actions across many PRs or items, a documented bulk API or CLI batch operations, and independent corroboration.
